finalText:
Fixed the flat-coupon bug in `src/services/pricing.js`. The issue was applying the coupon after currency conversion instead of before.

When a flat coupon (stored in USD) gets subtracted from an already-converted total, it's treated as if it were in the target currency. For a $10 coupon on a $100 order in EUR, this gave $80 instead of $81.

The fix: subtract the USD coupon from the USD subtotal first, then convert the discounted amount. All 5 tests pass now.
